title: Sixth Station: Veronica Wipes the Face of Jesus
text:
Consider how the holy woman named Veronica, seeing Jesus so afflicted, and His face bathed in sweat and blood, presented Him with a towel with which He wiped His adorable face, leaving on it the impression of His holy countenance.

My most beloved Jesus, Thy face was beautiful before, but
in this journey it has lost all its beauty, and wounds and blood
have disfigured it. Alas, my soul also was once beautiful, when
it received Thy grace in Baptism; but I have disfigured it
by my sins. Thou alone, my Redeemer, canst restore it to its
former beauty. Do this by Thy Passion; and grant that I may
be cleansed by Thy Precious Blood.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
